issue.title: Run flake8 on all environments

repository.name: vcrpy
repository.description: Automatically mock your HTTP interactions to simplify and speed up testing

issue.body:
dc9cd422 introduced Travis checking of flakes using tox.
However tox.ini only defined 'flakes-py34', so Travis
was only invoking flake8 on Python 3.4, and invoking
py.test on other Python versions.

As tox factors only work properly on the default `testenv`,
use a generic tox environment 'flakes' which uses the
default Python version, which Travis will set.

issue.title: Add support for Elliptic Curve Pkey

repository.name: pyopenssl
repository.description: A Python wrapper around the OpenSSL library

issue.body:
This is largely inspired by https://github.com/pyca/pyopenssl/pull/195/ but with a different approach regarding generate_key arguments.
Instead of keeping the 'bits' argument, I replaced it with a 'param' argument.
When called, generate_key will check the 'param' value according to the Pkey 'type'.
When 'type' is RSA or DSA, 'param' must be an int value specifying the key bits length.
When 'type' is EC, 'param' must be the name of an elliptic curve.
